night-garden: 起始帐篷向上、向左，再沿竖井向下；循泡泡到挑战房，完成战斗后找到鸟形石像。
From the start tent, go up, left and down the shaft. Follow the bubbles to the challenge room and clear it.
下方帐篷左上方的平台；用弹弓到达鸟形石像。
Use Slingshot to reach the bird statue just left and above the bottom tent.
上方帐篷出发，经瞭望塔边缘向左，再下行开门；位置在井底入口正上方，需要悬浮。
From the top tent, travel left through the edge of Lookout Tower, descend and open the gate above the Well entrance. Hover is required.
hunters-cabin: 从小屋中部向右三间房，向上三间房；完成计时挑战后到达，需悬浮。
From the cabin center, travel three rooms right and three rooms up. Complete the time trial; Hover is required.
the-bog: 从左侧帐篷向右、向下、向左，完成计时挑战。
From the left tent, go right, down and left, then complete the time trial.
从上方帐篷向左两间、向上两间，完成敌人挑战；需悬浮。
From the top tent, travel two rooms left and two rooms up, then clear the enemy challenge. Hover is required.
the-drains: 从中部帐篷向右，借乘风气流上升至左侧平台。
From the center tent, go right and ride the updraft to the platform on the left. Wind Ride is required.
graven-valley: 从墓谷帐篷向右三间房再下行；上部偏左有隐藏墙，穿过后抵达。
From the valley tent, go three rooms right and then down. Cross the illusory wall toward the upper-left side.
midnight-drench: 从荒堡中部帐篷向左三间、向下两间，再向左两间。
From the castle center tent, go three rooms left, two down and two left.
从本区上方帐篷向右两间，靠近蛛雨旅店的计时挑战石像；完成挑战。
From the top tent, go two rooms right toward Webdrench Inn and complete the time trial.
desiccated-castle: 从上方帐篷向右并向上；鸟灵下方有隐藏墙，在正下方利用弹弓平台上升。
From the top tent, go right and up. Find the illusory wall below the statue and use a Slingshot platform to rise.
lookout-tower: 从下方帐篷向下、向右，进入泡泡挑战房。
From the bottom tent, go down and right into the bubble challenge room.
从下方帐篷向左并上行三间，到尖刺分岔后一直向右；需要三次飞行时间提升。
From the bottom tent, go left and up three rooms to the spiked fork, then continue right. Three flight-time increases are required.
autumn-forest: 从左侧帐篷向右两间，经摩天轮向上两间，再向左完成计时挑战。
From the left tent, go two rooms right, two up by the ferris wheel, then left to the time trial.
从右侧帐篷向下、向左，解开蘑菇房机关；下一房间需利用弹弓平台与蘑菇反弹。
From the right tent, go down and left through the mushroom puzzle; use a Slingshot platform and mushrooms in the next room.
the-docks: 从左下帐篷向右、右上、再向右；中央隐藏墙可向下进入。
From the lower-left tent, go right, up-right and right. Drop through the hidden wall near the center.
从右侧帐篷向上三间房，在左端平台寻找。
From the right tent, go up three rooms and check the platform at the left end.
dollmakers-house: 位于玩偶师之家上方帐篷的正上方。
Directly above the top tent in Dollmaker's House.
burial-vault: 从右侧帐篷向左两间，再走右上出口；在移动墙上放置弹弓平台后向上。
From the right tent, go left twice and take the upper-right exit. Use a Slingshot platform on the moving wall.
从右侧帐篷向左、向下、向左、向上、向右；把弹弓平台置于尖刺之间并向上弹。
From the right tent, go left, down, left, up and right. Place a Slingshot platform among the spikes and launch upward.
